title: PageDocument
description: Tenant-scoped record that binds a content page to a template and stores widget placement for each region. Frozen at v1 — see 'Page Document Shape — Frozen at v1' in specs/crosscut/page-templates.md. The WidgetInstance entry shape is reused from page-layout.v1.json to guarantee one widget-entry shape across the platform.

pageId.description: Tenant-scoped page identifier (kebab-case). Stable across template changes.

templateId.description: Template this page binds to. MUST match a template registered in the active bundle (INV-TEMPLATE-02).

templateVersion.description: Semantic version of the template the page was last saved against. A stored version greater than the registered template's version MUST fail closed at render time (INV-TEMPLATE-08).

regions.description: Map of region name to ordered array of widget instances. Region names MUST exist in the resolved template's manifest (INV-TEMPLATE-02); required regions MUST be non-empty (INV-TEMPLATE-05).

meta.description: Optional page-level metadata (title, slug, SEO fields).

$comment: This shape is frozen at v1. Both InMemoryPageStore and the future HttpPageStore MUST round-trip byte-equivalent. Breaking changes require page-document.v2.json — not an in-place edit. Reuses WidgetInstance from page-layout.v1.json (INV-WIDGET-10 compatibility). INTENTIONAL DIVERGENCE from the duplicated copy at packages/page-templates/src/schemas/page_document.schema.json: that copy carries an additional layoutId/layoutVersion data-driven-layout branch plus a top-level oneOf requiring either {templateId,templateVersion} or {layoutId,layoutVersion}. The layout binding is a frontend rendering concern of the parked CMS app (a page binds to a LayoutDocument resolved at render time via LayoutRegistry/LayoutStore — see packages/page-templates/src/layout/); it is validated only by the package-local AJV in packages/page-templates/src/document.ts (the live validatePageDocument path that the authoring app's seed pages flow through). This canonical copy is the control-plane contract record and has no active runtime consumer (it is NOT among the schema_registry entries seeded by adapters/node/src/migrations/seed.ts, and modules/content-pages uses its own hand-written PageDocument subset in src/types.ts, not this JSON schema). The control-plane deliberately does not carry the CMS layout-binding abstraction; the divergence is preserved rather than unified per ticket chore/page-document-canonical-sync.
